definitions.title: Constrained Partial Derivative Notation
definitions.statement: When variables w, x, y, z are related by one or more constraint equations, the symbol (dw/dx)_y denotes the partial derivative of w with respect to x holding y constant, meaning x and y are selected as the independent variables while other variables are eliminated.
conditions: Constraint system can be solved locally for dependent variables
definitions.explanation: In multivariable systems with constraints, dw/dx is ambiguous unless the remaining held-constant independent variables are explicitly designated.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Subscripts outside the parentheses identify which variables are held fixed.

definitions.title: Triple Product (Cyclic) Rule
definitions.latex: \left( \frac{\partial x}{\partial y} \right)_z \left( \frac{\partial y}{\partial z} \right)_x \left( \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} \right)_y = -1
definitions.statement: For any smooth constraint relation F(x, y, z) = 0 connecting three variables, the cyclic product of their constrained partial derivatives equals -1.
conditions: All partial derivatives exist and are non-zero
definitions.explanation: Follows from implicit differentiation: (dx/dy)_z = -F_y / F_x, etc., causing numerator and denominator terms to cancel with three negative signs (-1)^3 = -1.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Fundamental identity in chemical thermodynamics relating P, V, and T equations of state.
